method: Independent bounded JPEG/XMP/EXIF and MP4 structure reads plus reviewed Takeout sidecars and saved direct HTTP originals; no checker imports and no photo decoding

motion_component_container_creation_expe.relation_proof: Standalone video SHA-256 equals the exact source JPEG appended XMP-offset video segment SHA-256; no filename association
motion_component_container_creation_expe.limitation: The compared field is video-container creation time. The eight files encode no numeric timezone offset in this integer field. UTC interpretation is format-conventional and agrees with the independent standalone video control; it is not a claim that this equals the photographic shutter instant.

negative_control.meaning: Another source JPEG carrying the identical explicit-offset XMP timestamp contradicts its own Takeout capture epoch. This is evidence against blindly trusting that XMP offset. It does not prove the edited file has the same true capture instant.

edited_image.limitation: No same-image coding hash or explicit metadata derivation identifies a trusted sidecar parent for this edited file. Similar names and wall-clock values are not parent proof. Its XMP declares a timestamp, but neither its true capture instant nor the destination timestamp can be reconciled from reliable source evidence.

auxiliary_json.scope: Only this exact known path/name with a parsed empty object is established by this corpus. No expectation is established for nonempty comments, arbitrary JSON or malformed files.

recommended_attention_effect.eight_unavailable_date_rows: Replace with explicit container-creation preservation evidence, retaining capture-time limitation
recommended_attention_effect.three_empty_auxiliary_rows: Replace with one informational auxiliary record while retaining the three-byte source hash inventory
recommended_attention_effect.edited_image: Retain one actionable date uncertainty or declared timestamp difference until stronger evidence exists

v0_1_4_expected_evidence_counts.scope: Expected row counts presume one separate finding for each timestamp/auxiliary proof as described by the implementation plan; final actual report audit must establish the complete set.

references.use: Movie atom creation field uses seconds since 1904, preferably UTC; it describes movie creation rather than shutter capture.
EXIF DateTimeOriginal and GPS timestamp semantics; GPS data time is UTC but is not necessarily the exact shutter instant.
XMP dates may omit a timezone; missing numeric offset must not be guessed.

privacy: No coordinates, account URLs, credentials, full EXIF/XMP packets or private absolute paths are included.
